Más que un “tesoro”, ese dinero podría representar los ahorros, el trabajo o la única esperanza de una familia que perdió su hogar durante la emergencia. Reflexión: Una tragedia no debe convertirse en una oportunidad para aprovecharse del dolor ajeno. Nuestra verdadera riqueza se encuentra en la honestidad, la empatía y la voluntad de ayudar. Lo correcto sería intentar localizar a su dueño o entregar lo encontrado a las autoridades correspondientes. 📖 “El que es fiel en lo muy poco, también en lo más es fiel.” — Lucas 16:10 🙏 Que Dios toque cada corazón y permita que las pertenencias recuperadas regresen a sus verdaderos propietarios. THE FLOOD LASTED HOURS. THE ECONOMIC DAMAGE COULD LAST YEARS. 🇳🇵 Nepal’s August 26 flash flood is no longer only a humanitarian disaster. It is becoming an economic and political crisis. 💰 $2.56 BILLION IN PRELIMINARY DAMAGE Initial assessments estimate approximately NPR 387.5 billion (US$2.56B) in direct damage to homes, roads, bridges, energy, agriculture and telecommunications. ⚡ HYDROPOWER HIT Around 281 MW of operating hydropower capacity and another 388 MW under construction were affected—significant for a country heavily dependent on hydropower. 🇨🇳 TRADE DISRUPTED Damage around Rasuwagadhi disrupted a critical Nepal–China trade corridor that handled more than $600M in trade in 2025. 🏠 THOUSANDS OF HOMES Preliminary assessments identified approximately 7,570 damaged homes, while commercial insurance losses could exceed NPR 20 billion (~US$132M). 🏛️ THE POLITICAL COST The government is facing pressure over disaster preparedness, rescue speed and coordination while thousands remain missing. Nepal has also requested international assistance for specialized rescue equipment and infrastructure. The water may disappear quickly. The economic and political consequences could remain for years. 🇳🇵
